positions.name: AtlasRollbackRehearsalDecisionRecord
positions.frame: what is the settled operational decision governing Atlas rollback rehearsals — its cadence and who owns it?
positions.why: src-1 issues the directive setting the monthly cadence, src-3 restates that cadence as a settled declarative label, and src-4 declaratively assigns ownership — all three are decision-grade performed acts (directive/declarative, not argued) that together constitute the formal record of the decision, read in the direction of 'what is now fixed operationally' rather than 'why it matters'. Kept apart from src-2, whose conviction reads as principle/maxim rather than decision, and whose justificatory register differs from the flat operational record these three share.
